From Wiktionary, the free dictionary

Asturian

[edit]

Verb

[edit]

percorrer

  1. to travel (all around); to go round

Conjugation

[edit]

This verb needs an inflection-table template.

Further reading

[edit]
  • “percorrer”, in Diccionariu de la llingua asturiana [Dictionary of the Asturian Language] (in Asturian), 1st edition, Academy of the Asturian Language [Asturian: Academia de la Llingua Asturiana], 2000, →ISBN

Portuguese

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

From Latin percurrere, equivalent to per- +‎ correr.

Pronunciation

[edit]
 
  • (Brazil) IPA(key): /peʁ.koˈʁe(ʁ)/ [peh.koˈhe(h)]
  • (Brazil) IPA(key): /peʁ.koˈʁe(ʁ)/ [peh.koˈhe(h)]
    • (São Paulo) IPA(key): /peɾ.koˈʁe(ɾ)/ [peɾ.koˈhe(ɾ)]
    • (Rio de Janeiro) IPA(key): /peʁ.koˈʁe(ʁ)/ [peχ.koˈχe(χ)]
    • (Caipira) IPA(key): /peɻ.koˈʁe(ɻ)/ [peɻ.koˈhe(ɻ)]
 
  • (Portugal) IPA(key): /pɨɾ.kuˈʁeɾ/
  • (Portugal) IPA(key): /pɨɾ.kuˈʁeɾ/
    • (Southern Portugal) IPA(key): /pɨɾ.kuˈʁe.ɾi/

  • Hyphenation: per‧cor‧rer

Verb

[edit]

percorrer (first-person singular present percorro, first-person singular preterite percorri, past participle percorrido)

  1. to travel
  2. to roam, wander
